notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_3.md 4.3.1/5. Own script scripts/run_cb3_quote_state.py (the doc's argv named run_cb1_extract.py; moved so CB1/CB2 stay untouched, challenger item 10). Membership = E001-tight at c or any of the 4 previous complete captures, plus <capture_id>.ids.csv.gz.
